name.en: Griffe coffee table

text.en:
Stones and shapes framed in wood, daring perspectives, plays of light and hidden preciousness characterise the three Griffe coffee tables. Designers Giorgetti R&D, Giancarlo Bosio 2022

Series of coffee or living room tables in different shapes and sizes, made from a clever mix of materials."Griffe is a small family of three low tables, with different cuts and heights, united by a refined combination of joints and layers. Low, jewelled tables that are crafted using special details and materials—wood, leather and marble—designed with absolute visual and constructive simplicity,in the most natural way for a craftsman to put two wooden boards together. The interplay of the joints creates acute and obtuse angles that produce the effect of an unusual and apparently random installation."—Giancarlo Bosio, Giorgetti R&D

name.en: Montgomery armchair

text.en:
Classically inspired, the Montgomery family of seats stands out for its dynamic and contemporary style.

Armchair in ash wood and leather. Removable cover in fabric or leather."Montgomery is a project born from a single detail. The Austrian knot—a type of lacing that characterises Montgomery coats of the ‘80s and ‘90s—was the cornerstone and the focus of the project. The lines of the chair and the small armchair revolve around this detail and recall the collections of some historic designers from the 1970s. We all tend to design chairs that are beautiful when seen from the front, but in reality you normally see a chair from the back because it faces a table in the home. We wanted to lend importance, character and personality to the chair even when it is not being used and is simply being looked at."—Dainelli Studio

text.en:
On the occasion of HOMO FABER 2026, the most prestigious international exhibition dedicated to celebrating artisanal excellence and showcasing contemporary savoir-faire, Giorgetti presents a special edition of the Summa pouf, created exclusively for the occasion, in collaboration with the Artistic Direction of Es Devlin. A project that celebrates the dialogue between design and fine craftsmanship, highlighting meticulous attention to detail, material research and artisanal expertise, giving rise to a distinctive expression of timeless elegance. Designers Giorgetti R&D, Giancarlo Bosio 2026

Comprising three distinct elements, Summa is born from a refined balance of material, colour and texture. Selected fabrics and leathers come together in a harmonious and distinctive composition, where every detail reveals a precise aesthetic pursuit.The finishes, selected in collaboration with the Artistic Direction of Es Devlin, enhance the essence of the “HOMO FABER 2026 | An Island of Light” project and embody Giorgetti’s most authentic values: artisanal mastery, material research and a sensitive and sophisticated attention to detail.

text.en:
A reminder of the 1930s concept with soft, romantic lines.

The first double bed with provision for fixed bedside tables.Two removable shells form the headboard,which has a limited depth."The Vibe bed partly recalls designs from the 1930s. The headboard has a band that swivels as if it were a work of art. It is accompanied by the round Side Vibe bedside table, which can be hooked onto the bed frame or placed on the floor.
